## Load data

```{r load-data}
PTcells <- readRDS(paste0(SCIndir, "PIPSeq_Annotated_OnlyPT_v0823.rds"))
PTcells <- UpdateSeuratObject(PTcells)

timepoint_order <- c("0DPI", "3DPI", "7DPI", "28DPI")

# Cluster order 0–6 (numeric, as produced by re-clustering)
cluster_order <- as.character(0:6)
Idents(PTcells) <- factor(PTcells@meta.data$seurat_clusters, levels = cluster_order)

cat("Cluster counts:\n")
print(table(PTcells@meta.data$seurat_clusters))
cat("Timepoints:\n")
print(table(PTcells@meta.data$DataSet))
```

## Shared setup – PT subset annotation

```{r shared-setup}
# Biological annotation of the 7 clusters.
# Verify with DotPlot output; adjust case_when if cluster numbers differ.
PTcells@meta.data <- PTcells@meta.data %>%
  mutate(PTAnnot = case_when(
    seurat_clusters == 0 ~ "S1",
    seurat_clusters == 1 ~ "S2",
    seurat_clusters == 2 ~ "S3",
    seurat_clusters == 3 ~ "Adaptive S1/S2",
    seurat_clusters == 4 ~ "Inflammatory PT",
    seurat_clusters == 5 ~ "S3-Injured",
    seurat_clusters == 6 ~ "Proliferating PT",
    TRUE ~ "Unknown"
  ))

annot_order <- c("S1", "S2", "S3", "Adaptive S1/S2", "S3-Injured", "Inflammatory PT", "Proliferating PT")
annot_order <- annot_order[annot_order %in% unique(PTcells@meta.data$PTAnnot)]

# Combined annotation × timepoint identity
PTcells@meta.data$AnnotTimepoint <- paste(
  PTcells@meta.data$PTAnnot,
  PTcells@meta.data$DataSet,
  sep = "_"
)
combined_order <- paste(
  rep(annot_order, each = length(timepoint_order)),
  timepoint_order,
  sep = "_"
)
combined_order <- combined_order[combined_order %in% unique(PTcells@meta.data$AnnotTimepoint)]
```

## Figure 5A: UMAP of PT subpopulations (numeric clusters 0–6)

```{r fig5a-umap-clusters, fig.width=5, fig.height=4}
Idents(PTcells) <- factor(PTcells@meta.data$seurat_clusters, levels = cluster_order)

Fig5A_UMAP <- DimPlot(
  PTcells,
  label   = TRUE,
  repel   = TRUE,
  pt.size = 0.5
) +
  labs(title = "Proximal tubule subpopulations") +
  theme(
    plot.title  = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9)
  )

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(Outdir, "Figure5A_PT_UMAP_Clusters.pdf"),
  plot     = Fig5A_UMAP,
  width    = 5, height = 4
)
Fig5A_UMAP
```

## Figure 5B: Dot plot of PT subset markers (S1/S2, adaptive, S3-injured)

```{r fig5b-dotplot-markers, fig.width=11, fig.height=4}
Idents(PTcells) <- factor(PTcells@meta.data$seurat_clusters, levels = rev(cluster_order))
DefaultAssay(PTcells) <- "RNA"

# Markers grouped by PT segment identity
PT_Panmarkers <- c(
"Lrp2","Cubn","Aqp1","Slc34a1",
"Ggt1","Slc4a4"
)
S1_biased_markers <- c("Lrp2","Cubn","Slc34a1","Slc5a12")

S2_biased_markers <- c("Slc5a2","Slc22a6","Slc22a8","Slc13a2","Slc22a2")

S2_biased__markers <- c("Aqp7","Slc7a13","Slc7a12","Inmt")

all_pt_markers <- c(S1_markers, S2_markers, S3_markers)
all_pt_markers <- all_pt_markers[all_pt_markers %in% rownames(PTcells)]

Fig5B_DotPlot <- DotPlot(
  PTcells,
  features  = all_pt_markers,
  cols      = c("RdBu"),
  dot.scale = 5
) +
  RotatedAxis() +
  labs(
    title = "PT subset marker expression (clusters 0–6)",
    x     = NULL,
    y     = "Cluster"
  ) +
  guides(
    colour = guide_colorbar(title = "AveExp"),
    size   = guide_legend(title  = "PerExp")
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title  = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8)
  )

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(Outdir, "Figure5B_PT_MarkerDotPlot.pdf"),
  plot     = Fig5B_DotPlot,
  width    = 5, height = 3
)
Fig5B_DotPlot
```

## Figure 5C: Stacked bar chart of PT subset composition across timepoints

```{r fig5c-proportion, fig.width=5, fig.height=4}
Idents(PTcells) <- factor(PTcells@meta.data$seurat_clusters, levels = rev(cluster_order))
prop_df <- table(PTcells@meta.data$DataSet, PTcells@meta.data$seurat_clusters) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::rename(Timepoint = Var1, Subset = Var2) %>%
  group_by(Timepoint) %>%
  mutate(pct = prop.table(Freq)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    Timepoint = factor(Timepoint, levels = timepoint_order),
    Subset    = factor(Subset,    levels = cluster_order)
  )

Fig5C_Prop <- ggplot(prop_df, aes(x = Timepoint, y = pct, fill = Subset)) +
  geom_bar(position = "stack", stat = "identity") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format()) +
  labs(x = "Timepoint", y = "Proportion", title = "PT subset composition across timepoints") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    plot.title  = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 9)
  )

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(Outdir, "Figure5C_PT_Proportion.pdf"),
  plot     = Fig5C_Prop,
  width    = 4.5, height = 4
)
Fig5C_Prop
```

## Figure 5I: GO Biological Process enrichment dotplot per PT subset

```{r fig5i-go-enrichment, fig.width=12, fig.height=5}
Idents(PTcells) <- factor(PTcells@meta.data$PTAnnot, levels = annot_order)
DefaultAssay(PTcells) <- "SCT"

AllMarkers_pt <- FindAllMarkers(
  PTcells,
  min.pct         = 0.25,
  #logfc.threshold = 0.25,
  test.use        = "MAST",
  #only.pos        = TRUE
)

write.csv(
  AllMarkers_pt,
  file      = paste0(Outdir, "Figure5I_PT_DEGs.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

ClusterGenes_pt <- lapply(annot_order, function(cl) {
  AllMarkers_pt %>%
    filter(cluster == cl, p_val_adj <= 0.05, avg_log2FC >= 0.25) %>%
    pull(gene)
})
names(ClusterGenes_pt) <- annot_order
ClusterGenes_pt <- ClusterGenes_pt[sapply(ClusterGenes_pt, length) > 0]

GO_pt <- compareCluster(
  geneClusters = ClusterGenes_pt,
  fun          = "enrichGO",
  OrgDb        = "org.Mm.eg.db",
  ont          = "BP",
  keyType      = "SYMBOL",
  pvalueCutoff = 1
)

write.csv(
  as.data.frame(GO_pt),
  file      = paste0(Outdir, "Figure5I_PT_GO_BP.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

selected_go_pt <- c(
  # ROS / oxidative stress
  "reactive oxygen species metabolic process",
  "hydrogen peroxide metabolic process",
  "hydrogen peroxide catabolic process",
  "response to oxidative stress",
  "cellular response to oxidative stress",
  # Metabolic / energetics
  "cellular respiration",
  "generation of precursor metabolites and energy",
  "fatty acid metabolic process",
  "carboxylic acid catabolic process",
  "organic acid catabolic process",
  "NADP metabolic process",
  # Transport
  "ion transport",
  "organic anion transport",
  "amino acid transport",
  "sodium ion transport",
  "transmembrane transport",
  # Regulation
  "regulation of cellular pH",
  "intrinsic apoptotic signaling pathway",
  "regulation of apoptotic process",
  "response to hypoxia",
  # Inflammation
  "inflammatory response",
  "defense response to bacterium",
  "innate immune response",
  "neutrophil activation",
  "chemokine production",
  "cytokine production",
  "response to lipopolysaccharide"
)

Fig5I_GO <- dotplot(
  GO_pt,
  showCategory = selected_go_pt,
  font.size    = 9,
  label_format = 55,
  by           = "geneRatio"
) +
  coord_flip() +
  RotatedAxis() +
  labs(title = "GO Biological Process – PT subsets") +
  theme(
    plot.title  = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8)
  )

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(Outdir, "Figure5I_PT_GO_Dotplot.pdf"),
  plot     = Fig5I_GO,
  width    = 12, height = 5
)
Fig5I_GO
```

## Figure 5J: Monocle2 pseudotime trajectory of PT cells

```{r fig5j-monocle2-pseudotime, fig.width=5, fig.height=4}
library(monocle)

# Build CDS from PTcells count matrix
pt_counts <- as.matrix(LayerData(PTcells, layer = "counts"))
p_data    <- PTcells@meta.data
f_data    <- data.frame(gene_short_name = rownames(pt_counts),
                        row.names       = rownames(pt_counts))

pd  <- new("AnnotatedDataFrame", data = p_data)
fd  <- new("AnnotatedDataFrame", data = f_data)

CDS <- monocle::newCellDataSet(
  pt_counts,
  phenoData            = pd,
  featureData          = fd,
  lowerDetectionLimit  = 0.1,
  expressionFamily     = negbinomial.size()
)

CDS <- estimateSizeFactors(CDS)
CDS <- estimateDispersions(CDS)

# Filter genes expressed in >= 10 cells
CDS         <- detectGenes(CDS, min_expr = 0.1)
expressed_genes <- row.names(subset(CDS@featureData@data, num_cells_expressed >= 10))

# Select ordering genes: differentially expressed across timepoints × high dispersion
diff_test_res <- differentialGeneTest(
  CDS[expressed_genes, ],
  fullModelFormulaStr = "~DataSet",
  cores               = 1
)
ordering_genes_de <- row.names(subset(diff_test_res, qval < 0.01))

disp_table        <- dispersionTable(CDS)
ordering_genes_disp <- subset(
  disp_table,
  mean_expression >= 0.05 & dispersion_empirical >= 0.05 * dispersion_fit
)$gene_id

final_ordering_genes <- intersect(ordering_genes_de, ordering_genes_disp)
cat("Final ordering genes:", length(final_ordering_genes), "\n")

CDS <- setOrderingFilter(CDS, final_ordering_genes)

# Reduce dimensions with DDRTree and order cells
CDS <- reduceDimension(CDS, max_components = 2, method = "DDRTree")
CDS <- monocle::orderCells(CDS)

# Root the trajectory at the State enriched for 0DPI cells in clusters 0 and 1
root_state_fn <- function(cds) {
  origin_cells <- which(
    cds@phenoData@data$DataSet == "0DPI" &
    cds@phenoData@data$seurat_clusters %in% c(0, 1)
  )
  state_counts <- table(cds@phenoData@data$State[origin_cells])
  as.integer(names(state_counts)[which.max(state_counts)])
}
root_st <- root_state_fn(CDS)
CDS     <- monocle::orderCells(CDS, root_state = root_st)

# Panel J1: trajectory colored by cluster
Fig5J_Cluster <- plot_cell_trajectory(
  CDS,
  color_by  = "seurat_clusters",
  cell_size = 0.5,
  show_branch_points = TRUE
) +
  labs(title = "PT pseudotime – colored by cluster") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 9, face = "bold"))

# Panel J2: trajectory colored by pseudotime
Fig5J_Pseudo <- plot_cell_trajectory(
  CDS,
  color_by  = "Pseudotime",
  cell_size = 0.5,
  show_branch_points = TRUE
) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "plasma") +
  labs(title = "PT pseudotime – pseudotime score") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 9, face = "bold"))

# Panel J3: trajectory colored by timepoint
Fig5J_Time <- plot_cell_trajectory(
  CDS,
  color_by  = "DataSet",
  cell_size = 0.5,
  show_branch_points = TRUE
) +
  labs(title = "PT pseudotime – colored by timepoint") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 9, face = "bold"))

Fig5J <- cowplot::plot_grid(Fig5J_Cluster, Fig5J_Pseudo, Fig5J_Time, nrow = 1)

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(Outdir, "Figure5J_PT_Monocle2_Pseudotime.pdf"),
  plot     = Fig5J,
  width    = 14, height = 4
)
Fig5J
```
